channel.title: Paksh: Politics
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.description: The UK government is reportedly considering a significant expansion of its social media ban for individuals under 16, which could extend to platforms like YouTube Kids, Spotify, LegoPlay, Vinted, and eBay. Sources briefed on the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Mississippi Senate Race Faces Ballot Deadline Issues
item.description: Ballot deadlines for the Mississippi Senate race have passed, following considerable struggles. Election results could be available as soon as Friday. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: Following midterm election losses, Republicans are reportedly digging in their heels. The Economist noted that the party is seeking to "get this party restarted" after reeling from the results. CNN's coverage also indicated a similar… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: Indonesia's Vice President has indicated an intention to resign following questions raised about his qualifications. Lawmakers are reportedly considering a probe into the matter, with the Vice President's fate hanging in the balance. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Olympic Champion Teddy Riner Enters French Presidential Race
item.description: Olympic judo champion Teddy Riner has announced his intention to run for the French presidency in 2027. The announcement was made by Riner, a decorated athlete, who is now entering the political arena. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: Lawmakers in the United States have begun moves to impeach Pete Hegseth. The specific reasons for the impeachment proceedings and the subsequent steps in the process were not detailed in the coverage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Russia's Novaya Gazeta Newspaper Closes Moscow Office
item.description: Novaya Gazeta, described as Russia's last major independent newspaper, has shut its Moscow office after more than 30 years of operation. The newspaper's closure follows a period of increasing pressure on independent media in Russia. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Biden confronted by pro-Palestine protesters in Dublin
item.description: Former US President Joe Biden was confronted by pro-Palestine protesters during an event at Dublin's Trinity College. Objects were reportedly pelted at him. Two individuals were taken into custody following the incident. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Following the recent Israeli election, Gadi Eisenkot has begun the process of forming a coalition government. He faces a significant challenge in bringing together disparate political factions to form an 'improbable coalition'. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.description: Following midterm election setbacks, former U.S. President Donald Trump has urged the Senate to expedite the confirmation of 161 pending nominations. This call comes as Trump continues to make public appearances and comments after the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 2.

item.title: US Skips UN Human Rights Review for First Time
item.description: The United States is set to become the first nation to refuse a review of its human rights record by the UN Human Rights Council. This decision has drawn criticism. The US will be staying away from this UN review. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Thousands of farmers protested in Maharashtra against a rule change by the BJP government concerning the Gokul Dairy elections. The farmers allege a conspiracy to take over the dairy and are protesting the ordinance. The protest involved… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: The Congress government in Karnataka spent an average of Rs 43.24 lakh per day on advertisements. This information was reported by The News Minute. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.description: Former President Pranab Mukherjee had expressed a desire to become Prime Minister, a revelation that surprised Sonia Gandhi, according to her writings. Mukherjee reportedly wished to replace Manmohan Singh as Prime Minister. These details… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.description: Maharashtra Chief Minister Eknath Shinde has intervened to prevent the relocation of flights from Mumbai's existing airport to the new Navi Mumbai airport. This decision comes amidst a dispute concerning the Mumbai airport operator's plans… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.
